the presented system allows straightforward affinity blotting of gene products, and that the Z(SPA)-tagged proteins can be recovered from inclusion bodies by affinity chromatography in the presence of denaturants.
the Z(SPA1) tag is very suitable for protein expression, as it can be easily detected by Western blotting, and the expressed proteins can be easily recovered by protein A affinity chromatography.
